verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents training the agent on standard operating procedures and running actions inside both natural-language and deterministic workflows. It also describes 'pockets of determinism for regulated steps', structured logic for compliance, and workflows you can build, edit, deploy and test via simulations. That covers the core of encoding SOPs the agent follows for known topics. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of deterministic branching/conditional logic within workflows, step-by-step workflow-editor detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
